purpose: Track shadcn-level Material3 parity maturity by axis: style chrome, layout density, behavior state, accessibility semantics, and motion interaction.

source_precedence.visual_chrome: Material spec, then MUI defaults, then Compose tokens
source_precedence.layout_density: Material spec, then upstream implementation ownership, then Fret caller-owned layout rule
source_precedence.behavior_state: Compose Material3 first, then MUI web composition
source_precedence.accessibility_semantics: Compose Material3 semantics, then Base UI headless parts, then MUI browser outcomes
source_precedence.motion_interaction: Material spec intent, then Compose MotionScheme and Fret fixed-timestep diagnostics
